title: Standard charts of a graded Proj morphism
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ and $B=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}B_n$ be commutative unital nonnegatively graded rings, with $1\in A_0,B_0$ and multiplication respecting degrees. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism satisfying $\varphi(A_n)\subseteq B_n$ for every $n$. Put $A_+=\bigoplus_{n>0}A_n$ and $B_+=\bigoplus_{n>0}B_n$, and assume $B_+\subseteq (\varphi(A_+))B$, the ideal of $B$ generated by the image of $A_+$. There is a canonical morphism $r_\varphi:\operatorname{Proj}(B)\to\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj]. For every $f\in A_a$ with $a>0$, one has $r_\varphi^{-1}(D_+(f))=D_+(\varphi(f))$. Under the standard affine chart identifications its restriction is the spectrum morphism induced by the ring homomorphism $$A_{(f),0}\longrightarrow B_{(\varphi(f)),0},\qquad h/f^e\longmapsto\varphi(h)/\varphi(f)^e\quad(e\geq0,\ h\in A_{ea})$$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero]. No finite generation, nonzero-ring or nonnilpotence hypothesis is imposed.
